purpose: Plan B B0 content proposal: maps each frozen Studio story task type to its immutable input/output artifact types so Plan A envelopes, Plan B handlers, and Plan C schemas agree before implementation-specific shapes are invented.
selection_rule: Idea selection and human approval are synchronous/idempotent commands that unblock an orchestrator node; they are not hidden model tasks and they never appear in this task map.

tasks.note: IdeaCandidateSet contains 3-5 distinct, age-appropriate IdeaCandidate records and score dimensions.
Evaluation annotates the set with deterministic score dimensions; selection is the human/approval command, not this task.
The three bibles validate and promote as one consistent set; downstream fixtures reference canon IDs, not free-form names alone.
BeatSheet references character/world IDs and allocates the 180-300 second target budget among beats.
EpisodeOutline carries scene intent, location, characters, conflict/change, dialogue budget and estimated seconds.
Structured JSON draft is authority; canonical screenplay text is a derived view.
ReviewReport aggregates deterministic findings + model-assisted narrative review with stable codes/severity/location/evidence.
Produces a new immutable draft plus a structural/semantic diff; never mutates the reviewed draft.
A-issued LockedScreenplayReceipt is the authority; the package references immutable approved artifacts plus a manifest/checksums.
